en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a rural mountainous landscape with a village partially obscured by trees. A church with a pointed steeple stands out in the center, surrounded by buildings and hills. The foreground features a fence and a path, while the background displays a range of mountains under a cloudy sky. The border and print style suggest an early to mid-20th century origin. The caption at the bottom reads: 'COREDO (m. 831) - Valle di Non - Stazione Climatica.'
